review_notes: I read the whole file and the Foundation definitions it uses: Point, Hessian, Jet, quadraticModel, SemijetRemainder, HasSecondOrderExpansionWithin(AtValue) and TouchesAboveOn. Superjet and Subjet are the Crandall–Ishii–Lions second-order semijets. I know of no Mathlib counterpart for second-order semijets, viscosity jets or an o(|x-x0|^2) one-sided expansion, and I did not search Mathlib for one. SemijetRemainder is a named specialisation of Asymptotics.IsLittleO, and the rubric says such names are not defects. Jet is a plain gradient-and-Hessian pair, and it lives in Foundation rather than in the target file. SuperjetExcess, SubjetExcess and SecondOrderNonposWithin are small helper definitions, each used in the equivalence theorems in this file. I found no independent competing duplicate of a Mathlib concept. The other theorem-level overlaps (the congruence lemmas, the sub/super mirror proofs) fall under standalone theorem duplication, which the rubric excludes.
